'''Ancient ruins''' were located on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] that was home to [[Abeloth]]&mdash;a powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity. It was also found in the realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]], which was commonly accessed by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] known as the [[Mind Walkers]], who reached the realm by separating their minds from their bodies.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

The ruins housed a courtyard surrounded by an arcade with an interior wall lined with three-meter doorways&mdash;inside was a series of cavernous habitation cells with benches the size of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and stone [[Sleeper (furniture)|bunks]] large enough to house [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. At the center of the open courtyard was the [[Font of Power]], a fountain that offered unlimited to power to those who drank from it. The ruins were covered by [[sinuous carvings]] that depicted what seemed to be serpents, vines, tentacles, ropes, or entrails, resembling the [[ophidian grotesques]] style on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The symbols were recognized by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] as those affiliated with the [[Destructors]]&mdash;a race of beings in the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] mythos who wiped out civilization every few eons; a legend that the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] had come to believe as true.<ref name="Vortex" />

Following the [[Mission to the Maw|defeat]] of Abeloth in [[44 ABY]] by a joint [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith strike force, the Jedi and Sith [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Sarasu Taalon, explored the ruins on the world, hoping to learn more about Abeloth's nature from them.<ref name="Vortex" />
